candidate_label: B: route-cohort page-cost-trained shared nonlinear GU feature groups with expert-specific Down
main_hypothesis: A fixed original selected-expert cohort can reuse learned partial nonlinear GU feature groups once; a nonadditive full-page/plane cost can find a quality/capacity operating point that independent sparse support learning plus best post-layout and whole-expansion sharing do not attain. Test, do not assume, necessity and publication value.

model_family.Down: Each expert retains its own H-dimensional Down coefficients on its selected feature groups. No scalar shared-output-atom trick.
model_family.original_router: Retain original selection and actual alpha semantics as interface. Student later-layer routing may drift under genuine inference and must be evaluated.
model_family.original_shared_expert: Optional and preserved/accounted separately; not required by the mechanism.
model_family.initial_bounded_budget: M=4*I shared GU atoms, s=I atoms per expert; T=128 neurons/group for known I1024/1408, no claim one group equals a NAND page. Final executable recipe may be selected during thought then frozen before tests.
model_family.cost: Expected legal fullpage/plane service of union support under actual selected cohort; expert-specific Down, quant metadata, host nonlinear, vector input/output and finite state remain paid.

must_not_assume: Feature similarity or co-selection implies adequate shared nonlinear representation
